walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 4: A Global Perspective — a core area of A-Level Economics.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 4: A Global Perspective brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 4: A Global Perspective.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Is a trade deficit necessarily bad?
options: Not necessarily — it can reflect strong domestic demand, attractive investment opportunities, or borrowing to fund growth. Context matters more than the headline figure.
A trade deficit means a country has no factories.
Inflation is when the economy grows too fast.
A trade deficit always means a country is losing wealth and failing economically.
